independentEvidence.source: National Library of the Czech Republic — Kramerius
independentEvidence.finding: The exact 1883 monograph Česká kuchařka is catalogued under author Hanna Dumková, not Marie Dumková; publisher Alois Hynek, Prague, [1883], 636 pages.
Hana/Hanna Dumková is identified as a Czech cookbook writer (1847–1920) and Česká kuchařka (1883) is listed among her works with the National Library copy.

independentEvidence.source: Czech Republic e-Sbírka — Act No. 121/2000, sections 27–28
independentEvidence.finding: Economic copyright generally lasts for the author's life plus 70 years; once the term expires the work may be freely used subject to the remaining statutory conditions. The apparent age therefore does not cure an incorrect source-author identity in this project's provenance ledger.

reason: The pinned ORA source-author field identifies Marie Dumková, while the Czech National Library's exact 1883 monograph record identifies Hanna Dumková and independent author records identify Hana/Hanna Dumková. Exact provenance is therefore not sufficiently reliable to earn source-specific rights clearance.
rightsTermObservation: The identified Hana/Hanna Dumková died in 1920, so the work appears to be outside the ordinary Czech life-plus-70 economic-rights term. This observation does not override the attribution/provenance mismatch and is not used to admit the current ORA packet.
